title: LADA Beerteam vs Cluster Pucks, Sep 20
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie A: we wore white and had the left bench. The 3438x1374 video was scaled up to the rink's usual frame. The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API; the user also sent the scoresheet PDF) gave the score, the goals with scorers, the penalties, the shots and who played; the arena scoreboard and the video confirmed them.

Periods by the scoreboard clock: 0:12-18:13, 19:59-38:01 and 39:36-66:07 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; play went on to 0:00 in every period (unlike earlier Snoqualmie games), and the board ran a 1:00 countdown for each intermission. The video runs to the final horn. Shots on goal 30-30, as on the sheet and the board.

Goals at 23:14 (Cluster Pucks #22 Brooks), 27:38 (Solovyov #87, assist Egiazarov #27), 29:31 (Brooks), 32:00 (#91 Viswanathan), 33:35 (Brooks on the power play, his third), 44:39 (#36 Trefethen), 49:17 (Kleiman #69, assist Chernih #68), 53:26 (Bogdanov #10, assist Zakharov #34), 62:19 (#24 Patrick, into our empty net) and 65:34 (Bogdanov #10, assist Egiazarov #27, on the power play with 9 s left) of the video, each found by eye and matched to the sheet's clock time and the board.

Penalty kills: Papusha #25 (interference beside our crease, 2nd period, clock 4:36; a delayed call, the whistle at about 33:00; the board posted 3:00; ended 16 s of clock in by Brooks's power-play goal at 33:35) and Bogdanov #10 (slashing at the boards in front of their bench, 3rd, clock 5:21, 56:58-59:23, the full 2:00). Cluster Pucks took three minors (Terek #44 twice, Trefethen #36), our power plays.

Extra attacker: down 3-5 with about two minutes left, we pulled the goalie at 61:06; Cluster Pucks took a timeout at once (both teams at their benches until 61:44), and the six who came out of it, Zhaksilikov #23, Papusha #25, Egiazarov #27, Kleiman #69, Panov #76 and Solovyov #87, stayed on until the empty-net goal at 62:19; the timeout is credited to them. The goalie was back at about 62:34. The solve counts 6 skaters for that span (an "extra" entry in periods.json, new with this game).

Played: the 12 skaters the game sheet marks as playing (Prozhogin #61 and Panov #76 as subs). In goal was a substitute, David Pfeifer (a spare on the sheet; his number never showed on the video): neither Mayorov nor Starodubtsev played. Didn't play (marked absent for the solve): Zhaksilikov #5, Belousenko #11, Papusha #24, Gilderman #41, Shikhanov #70, Volkov #94 (on LADA's lines but never seen) and the other subs. Reads of 75, 15 and 14 were misreads of 25, 44 and 34.

Labeled by hand: 2nd-period row R272 (Khristoforov #7: a single 7 on his back at 35:36; the reviewers had #61). Seen by eye and set in periods.json: 1st period, Tverskoy #44 off from 12:50 (at the bench) and Kleiman #69 on 12:37-13:10. 2nd: Chernih #68 on 23:01-23:18 (his track swapped onto #27 before the goal against); Kleiman #69 on 25:07-26:59, 27:39-27:56 and 31:22-35:07 (his number rarely faces the camera; he killed Papusha's penalty with #27, #76 and #87); Khristoforov #7 on 27:35-27:57 and 35:33-36:36; Prozhogin #61 off 25:13-25:18, Tverskoy #44 off 27:39-27:47, Zakharov #34 off 32:02-32:22 and 33:11-33:52, Zhaksilikov #23 off 32:21-33:06. 3rd: Zhaksilikov #23 on 59:34-60:02 and Prozhogin #61 off 59:56-60:02; Khristoforov #7, Bogdanov #10, Tverskoy #44 and Prozhogin #61 off through the timeout; Kleiman #69 on 62:19-62:27 and Solovyov #87 on 62:28-62:42 after the empty-net goal; Egiazarov #27 off from 62:35.
